How many gas stations in CZE has Premium gas?

-- This SQL query counts the number of gas stations in the Czech Republic (CZE) belonging to the "Premium" segment.

FROM gasstations

entities.name: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS EUR_to_CZK_ratio
FROM customers AS T1

entities.name: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?

properties.sql: SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

entities.name: What was the average monthly consumption of customers in SME for the year 2013?

properties.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.Consumption) / 12 FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'

entities.name: Which customers, paying in CZK, consumed the most gas in 2011?

properties.sql:
-- Which customers, paying in CZK, consumed the most gas in 2011?
SELECT T2.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
    ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201101 AND 201112
GROUP BY T2.CustomerID
HAVING SUM(T2.Consumption) = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.TotalCons)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(T4.Consumption) AS TotalCons
        FROM customers AS T5
        INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T4
            ON T5.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
        WHERE T5.Currency = 'CZK'
          AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201101 AND 201112
        GROUP BY T4.CustomerID
    ) AS T3
)

entities.name: How many customers in KAM had a consumption of less than 30,000 for the year 2012?

properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T2.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND SUBSTRING(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T2.CustomerID HAVING SUM(T2.Consumption) < 30000 ) AS t1

entities.name: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?

properties.sql:
-- Difference in total gas consumption in 2012 between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL)
  - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) AS ConsumptionDifference
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

entities.name: Which year recorded the most gas use paid in EUR?

INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4)

entities.name: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?

entities.name: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

properties.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Consumption = ( SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth ) AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

entities.name: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?

properties.sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0))) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

properties.note: Rank customers by their aggregated (SUM) consumption, not by a single monthly row value.
properties.sql: ORDER BY SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) DESC

properties.note: Spending level per customer is recorded as yearmonth.Consumption, so the top spender is the customer whose consumption value is the maximum.
properties.sql: yearmonth.CustomerID WHERE yearmonth.Consumption = (SELECT MAX(yearmonth.Consumption) FROM yearmonth)

properties.note: When the question names a segment but asks which one consumed least, the ranking unit is the individual customer, so the consumption total must be ordered per customer (grouped by customers.CustomerID) and the segment is then read off that customer.
properties.sql: ORDER BY SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) ASC

properties.note: yearmonth.Date is stored as a 'YYYYMM' text string, so the year is the first four characters.
properties.sql: SUBSTR(yearmonth.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
